ctaHeading: Need a Regrouting Specialist in West Footscray?
aboutText: Save and Seal is West Footscray's trusted regrouting specialist, serving Melbourne homeowners with expert tile restoration, shower waterproofing, and balcony repair. We diagnose and fix leaking showers, crumbling grout, returning mould, and hidden moisture damage before it causes costly structural problems. Our skilled team delivers clean, durable results that protect your home and restore your bathroom to its best.
servicesText: From leaking showers to deteriorating grout lines, we tackle the problems that undermine your bathroom and balcony surfaces. Save and Seal delivers thorough, lasting solutions for residential and commercial properties across Melbourne.

services.title: Leaking Shower Repair
services.desc: We diagnose and permanently fix leaking showers in Melbourne homes, preventing water damage to walls, floors and subframes before it spreads.

services.title: Bathroom Regrouting
services.desc: Complete bathroom regrouting in West Footscray, removing old cracked grout and replacing it with fresh, waterproof seals that look like new.

services.title: Leaking Balcony Repair
services.desc: Expert leaking balcony repair for Melbourne properties, addressing waterproofing failures and restoring safe, dry outdoor tiled areas.

services.title: Grout Repair & Restoration
services.desc: Crumbly, cracked or discoloured grout fully removed and replaced with durable, colour-matched material for a clean, sealed finish.

services.title: Mould & Moisture Treatment
services.desc: We eliminate returning mould and underlying moisture issues in tiled areas, treating the root cause to stop it from coming back.

services.title: Tile Stabilisation
services.desc: Shifting or loose tiles re-secured and stabilised, preventing further damage and ensuring your tiled surfaces are safe and level.
